_comment: SessionStart hook for the whats-next plugin. Runs bin/gather.py with --as-prompt-injection at session start so the first turn already has a <whats-next>...</whats-next> JSON block in context. The skill body picks that up via its description match. Schema follows the Claude Code 'hooks' shape (settings.json hooks.SessionStart array). If your harness uses a different shape, the plugin loader is expected to translate; gather.py itself is the durable contract — it always exits 0 and writes JSON on stdout.
